message:
The yen receipt now shows `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is in `src/utils/money.js`. Its `formatMoney` divides every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file belongs to another team, so I didn't touch it. I fixed the receipt inside `src/payments/receipt.js` instead. It now formats yen amounts as whole units and sends every other currency through `formatMoney` as before.

Invoices, cart and admin presumably call `formatMoney` too, so they likely still show yen wrong. The better fix is to make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies, which is a change for the team that owns `src/utils`. If they make it, the special case in `receipt.js` can be removed.
